context: M16 o2. Ashgrove Trust, corner office. Whitlock taps a pen on a file.

lines.speaker: char.gordon_whitlock
lines.text: Nick, the bank loves you. The bank simply loves you less in July.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Gordon. Love is seasonal. Fur is seasonal. October, you'll love me again.

lines.speaker: char.gordon_whitlock
lines.text: We're not calling the loan. We're inviting it home. By September.

lines.speaker: char.gordon_whitlock
lines.text: And Nick? Someone suggested your vault is… popular collateral. Rumours.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Rumours from a man in a white suit, I'd guess.
